description: This file defines an internal generic class LogViewAdaptor<TLogView, TLogEntry> within the Orleans.EventSourcing.StateStorage namespace, responsible for batching and managing log view states, interactions with storage, and handling update notifications in an event-sourced storage context. It includes methods for reading/writing state asynchronously, merging notifications, and processing received notifications. The class also contains nested classes for error handling and notifications.

classes.name: LogViewAdaptor<TLogView, TLogEntry>
classes.description: An adaptor class managing log views with batching, E-tags, and notification processing in an Orleans event sourcing context.

classes.name: UpdateStateStorageFailed
classes.description: A sealed class representing failures during writing state to storage.

classes.name: ReadFromStateStorageFailed
classes.description: A sealed class representing failures during reading state from storage.

classes.name: UpdateNotificationMessage
classes.description: A serializable class representing a notification message with version, origin, updates, and ETag, used for informing about updates.

methods.name: LastConfirmedView
methods.description: Returns the last confirmed log view.

methods.name: GetConfirmedVersion
methods.description: Returns the global version of the last confirmed state.

methods.name: InitializeConfirmedView
methods.description: Initializes the confirmed view with an initial state.

methods.name: MakeSubmissionEntry
methods.description: Creates and returns a submission entry for a log entry.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads state from storage with retries on failure.

methods.name: WriteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes the current state to storage, with optimistic concurrency and retries.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges two notification messages if they are contiguous and from the same origin.

methods.name: OnNotificationReceived
methods.description: Processes incoming notification messages and stores them in a sorted list.

methods.name: ProcessNotifications
methods.description: Processes and applies stored notifications to the global state, discarding outdated ones.

methods.name: enter_operation
methods.description: Debug utility to mark start of an operation (conditional compilation).

methods.name: exit_operation
methods.description: Debug utility to mark end of an operation (conditional compilation).
